detector.note: The shipped blend, so this measures what /verify runs, not one half of it.

what_this_measures: The selfie detector on fakes this project did not generate, reported per generator family. The corpus in eval/metrics.json cannot see this: its fakes come from our own generator settings, and benchmark_models.py selected this checkpoint on that same corpus.

protocols.frame: Naive: whole source image into the shared capture path. Confounded wherever the classes differ in resolution; reported because it is what a careless evaluation would report.
protocols.face: Controlled: both classes face-detected, cropped at margin 0.4 and resized to 512px BEFORE the identical capture simulation. This is the number that describes the detector.

deepfakeface.source: OpenRL/DeepFakeFace - IMDB-WIKI photographs and three fakes of each
deepfakeface.pairing_note: Every fake is derived from the real image it is scored against, so identity, pose and subject are held fixed. Geometry is NOT held fixed: the genuine images are native IMDB-WIKI sizes and every fake is 512x512, which is why the frame protocol here is not a measurement of the detector.

families.inpainting: Stable Diffusion inpainting (face regenerated in a real photograph)
families.insight: InsightFace swap (a different face composited into a real photograph)

stylegan_140k.source: JamieWithofs/Deepfake-and-real-images - FFHQ photographs against StyleGAN faces, test split
stylegan_140k.pairing_note: Not paired, but both classes ship at 256x256, so this track is geometry-matched by construction and the frame protocol is closer to honest here than on DeepFakeFace.
stylegan_140k.leakage_warning: FFHQ-plus-StyleGAN is the most common fine-tuning set for off-the-shelf ViT deepfake checkpoints, and this one names no training data. A high score here cannot be distinguished from memorisation; read it beside the other families.

real_populations.source: LFW funneled - web-scraped news photography, already on disk
real_populations.why: A third genuine population, photographed nothing like FFHQ or IMDB-WIKI. The false-positive rate here is what an honest applicant pays, and it is the number a merchant feels.

headline.note: The worst family is the deployment number: an attacker picks the generator, not the defender. The spread is how much a pooled average would have hidden.
